title: Fix Gis Plugin Forbidden Web-Sys Dependency
description: The plugin-capability lint (`bun ./script.ts plugin lint` in framework/product/os/dev) fails with "[plugin-capability-lint] gis-plugin: forbidden dependency web-sys". gis/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml declares web-sys under the wasm32 target for a direct `web_sys::window().open_with_url(url)` call in `domain::open_url`, used by the gis2d "openSource" action to open a feature's source URL in a new tab. Plugins must be host-agnostic per the framework's plugin capability rules, so route this through the host bridge instead: add a `HostEffect::OpenExternalUrl { url }` variant to framework/core/rs/lib.rs's HostEffect enum (mirrored in framework/core/js/index.ts's HostEffect type and handled in framework/renderer/react/index.tsx's applyHostEffects via window.open), remove the web-sys dependency and open_url function from gis-plugin, and have the openSource action push the new HostEffect instead. Verify with `bun ./script.ts plugin lint` from framework/product/os/dev and `cargo check -p gis-plugin`.
